description:
Save a workspace contact with a name and a phone number or email address.

        A duplicate phone or email returns 409.
        Returns the new contact record or an error.

email.description: The address to email this contact at, such as ``ana@example.com``. Give this, ``phone_e164``, or both.
email.title: Email

llm_model.description: Model ID of the calling agent. Optional. Recorded for analytics only.

phone_e164.description: The number to call or text this contact on, such as ``+14155551234``. Give this, ``email``, or both.
phone_e164.title: Phone E164

name: create_contact
title: Create a contact
